Datia Bypoll: Ticket Denial Sparks Protests, BJP Faces Internal Discord

The Datia assembly by-election in Madhya Pradesh is marked by significant internal discord within the BJP following the denial of a ticket to former Home Minister Narottam Mishra. His supporters reacted with protests, including highway blockades and stone-pelting, leading to clashes with police. While Mishra has appealed for calm and stated his acceptance of the party's decision, the incident highlights internal rifts as the election campaign begins.
